scenario_stem:
Kettlebrook Coaches Ltd runs 12 bus routes in Country X, operating for 16 years and employing 54 drivers and 6 office staff. Fares revenue last year was $2.9 million, and ridership fell 3% last year on the two busiest routes. The legal minimum wage rises from $9.00 to $10.50 per hour on 1 April, and 45 of the 60 staff are on or near the minimum.

Option one is to raise fares by 8% from April, offsetting the extra wage cost of roughly $118,000 a year. Option two is to freeze fares and cut 9 driver overtime shifts per week, saving about $115,000 a year, but peak-time services may be reduced. The directors must announce their decision at the fare review in 6 weeks.
